Aditya Birla Sun Life

Super Term Plan review

4/ 5

Covers 42 critical illnesses inside the base plan — most insurers charge extra for that as a rider.

Aditya Birla Sun Life Super Term Plan scores 4/5 in our assessment. Aditya Birla Sun Life settles 98.7% of claims and draws 1.33 complaints per 10,000 claims. Cover runs ₹25 L – no maximum limit (subject to underwriting). Illustrative premiums start at ₹16,343 a year.

What Super Term Plan covers

  • Death from any cause during the policy term
  • Critical illness across 42 conditions — built in, no rider needed
  • Terminal illness — early payout of up to ₹1 crore
  • Accidental disability — premium waiver

Key features

  • Three variants — Level Cover, Increasing Cover (5% a year to 200%) and ROP
  • Accelerated critical illness built in — 42 illnesses, up to 50% of cover, capped at ₹50 lakh
  • Terminal illness payout of up to ₹1 crore included
  • Accidental total and permanent disability waives all future premiums
  • Life stage flexibility to raise cover at marriage, childbirth or a home purchase
  • Cover Continuance allows premium deferral under defined conditions

Riders and add-ons

  • Accidental Death
  • Waiver of Premium
  • Accelerated Critical Illness (built in)

What Super Term Plan does not cover

  • Suicide within 12 months of policy start or revival
  • Death traced to an undisclosed medical condition
  • Fraudulent claims or material misrepresentation
  • Self-inflicted injury within the exclusion period

What does Super Term Plan cost?

₹2 crore cover to age 65 · healthy non-smoker, salaried, Delhi (110010) · annual premium incl. GST

What we like

  • Built-in critical illness cover usually works out cheaper than a standalone rider
  • Only 1.33 complaints per 10,000 claims — second best of the five
  • The Increasing Cover variant grows 5% a year, which fights inflation over a 30-year term
  • The cheapest option at age 35 for both men and women
  • Early exit value available at certain ages and tenures

What we don't

  • At 98.70%, the lowest settlement ratio of the five
  • Solvency of 1.82x is the thinnest here, though still above the 1.5x minimum
  • The critical illness payout is capped at 50% of cover or ₹50 lakh, whichever is lower
  • Smaller distribution footprint in some states

Our verdict

The built-in critical illness cover is the whole argument for this plan, and it is a good one — bundling 42 conditions into the base premium usually beats buying a rider separately. The counterweight is that Aditya Birla Sun Life has the weakest insurer metrics of the five. If you want term and critical illness in a single policy and are comfortable with a 98.70% settlement ratio, this makes sense. If you would rather maximise claim certainty, take Axis Max Life and buy the rider.

Frequently asked questions

Is Aditya Birla Sun Life Super Term Plan a good plan?

We score it 4 out of 5. The built-in critical illness cover is the whole argument for this plan, and it is a good one — bundling 42 conditions into the base premium usually beats buying a rider separately. The counterweight is that Aditya Birla Sun Life has the weakest insurer metrics of the five. If you want term and critical illness in a single policy and are comfortable with a 98.70% settlement ratio, this makes sense. If you would rather maximise claim certainty, take Axis Max Life and buy the rider.

What is the claim settlement ratio of Aditya Birla Sun Life?

98.7%, as a three-year average for FY 2024–26 from IRDAI disclosures. Aditya Birla Sun Life receives 1.33 complaints per 10,000 claims.

How much cover can I take under Super Term Plan?

₹25 L – no maximum limit (subject to underwriting). Entry age is 18–65 yrs.

What does Super Term Plan not cover?

The main exclusions are: Suicide within 12 months of policy start or revival; Death traced to an undisclosed medical condition; Fraudulent claims or material misrepresentation; Self-inflicted injury within the exclusion period.
